headline: Applied AI & Backend Engineer
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction and hands-on experience taking computer vision, RAG, agentic, and classical ML systems beyond prototypes. Builds production-minded Python and FastAPI backends with Docker, evaluation, persistence, tests, and cloud ML workflows. Brings a strong public portfolio, open-source contributions, and a focus on reliable AI that creates measurable value.
internship_bullets: Built an end-to-end Python pipeline for echocardiographic DICOM studies using computer vision, OCR, structured data extraction, and review tooling.
Designed resumable processing, validation queues, traceable outputs, and cross-platform documentation so the research workflow could be used and extended reliably.
Optimised an OpenCV ECC and metadata-based source-video matcher from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes on one representative run.
apolloon_bullets: Engineered a production-used local-first platform with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO.
Designed realtime synchronisation, automatic LAN discovery, replicated hot-standby failover, health checks, and operator-safe workflows for unreliable event conditions.
